templates.title: AFFiNE
templates.name: affine
templates.description: AFFiNE 0.27.4 is a self-hosted workspace for docs, whiteboards, and knowledge bases, with Postgres and Redis.

env.name: REDIS_SERVER_HOST
env.label: REDIS_SERVER_HOST
env.description: Redis hostname on the Compose network.

env.name: DATABASE_URL
env.label: DATABASE_URL
env.description: Postgres URL for the AFFiNE server and migration job. Matches the postgres service, which uses trust authentication.

env.name: AFFINE_INDEXER_ENABLED
env.label: AFFINE_INDEXER_ENABLED
env.description: Disable the search indexer, matching the v0.27.4 release Compose file.

env.name: POSTGRES_USER
env.label: POSTGRES_USER
env.description: Postgres role created on first start.

env.name: POSTGRES_DB
env.label: POSTGRES_DB
env.description: Postgres database created on first start.

env.name: POSTGRES_HOST_AUTH_METHOD
env.label: POSTGRES_HOST_AUTH_METHOD
env.description: Auth method from the official Compose file. Connections on the Compose network do not use a password.
